toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Demo pricing comparison for headset-stand as of 2026-10-24 using synthetic direct-channel assumptions. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount scenario for each target. Discounted prices do not preserve the requested target revenue margin; realized revenue margins fell to ~12.23%, ~23.35%, and ~34.46% respectively.
assumptions: Product and rule are demonstration fixtures with confirmed synthetic provenance only; not business-confirmed data.
All charges are on the same revenue basis under the synthetic direct-channel rule: 10% channel rate, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is included as a modelled retry allowance based on the stored 10% failure rate and full-print retry assumption.
Prices are drafts only and require human approval before any operational use.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead may exist beyond the stored costs.
Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the cost model and may differ from actual scrap/rework behavior.
No marketplace verification was performed; the rule is synthetic and not a current Shopee fee schedule.

recommendation.summary: Demo pricing comparison for headset-stand as of 2026-10-24 using synthetic direct-channel assumptions. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount scenario for each target. Discounted prices do not preserve the requested target revenue margin; realized revenue margins fell to ~12.23%, ~23.35%, and ~34.46% respectively.
assumptions: Product and rule are demonstration fixtures with confirmed synthetic provenance only; not business-confirmed data.
All charges are on the same revenue basis under the synthetic direct-channel rule: 10% channel rate, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provision is included as a modelled retry allowance based on the stored 10% failure rate and full-print retry assumption.
Prices are drafts only and require human approval before any operational use.
limitations: Unmodeled overhead may exist beyond the stored costs.
Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the cost model and may differ from actual scrap/rework behavior.
No marketplace verification was performed; the rule is synthetic and not a current Shopee fee schedule.
